add.title: ADD AN ACCOUNT
add.icloudHint: Apple ID e-mail and an app-specific password
add.caldavHint: Fastmail, Nextcloud, Zoho, Yahoo, mailbox.org, your own…
add.label: Name shown in the widget
add.guideIcloud: Create one at account.apple.com › Sign-In and Security › App-Specific Passwords. Guide: docs/icloud.md
add.guideCaldav: Most providers want an app password rather than your main password. Guide: docs/caldav.md
settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.remindersDesc: Notify for the reminders set on each event, wherever they were set.
settings.notifyAtStartDesc: With a Join button when there is a video link.
settings.privateDesc: Hide titles and places in notifications and in the recap.
settings.recapDesc: A summary of the day at login and when waking up on a new day.
error.auth_failed: Wrong username or password. iCloud needs an app-specific password, not your Apple ID password.
error.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
error.timeout: The server took too long to answer.
error.conflict: The event changed somewhere else. Sync and try again.
error.missing_secret: The password is no longer in the keyring. Remove and add the account again.
error.missing_credentials: Fill in the username and password.
error.no_principal: That address did not answer like a CalDAV server.
error.no_calendar_home: That address did not answer like a CalDAV server.
error.no_calendars: No calendar with events was found on this account.
error.unsafe_xml: The server sent a response that was refused for safety.
error.bad_xml: The server sent a response that could not be read.
error.pending_expired: That took too long. Connect again.
error.bad_repeat: Check the repetition and its end date.
error.rate_limited: The server asks to slow down. Try again in a minute.
error.server_error: The server had a problem. Try again later.
error.unknown_event: That event is gone. It may have been deleted elsewhere.
error.corrupt_secrets: The saved passwords file is damaged. Fix or remove secrets.json in the agenda state folder, then try again.
add.googleHint: Read and write, with your own Google Cloud OAuth client (5 minutes, once)
add.icsHint: Read only: Google or Proton secret address, holidays, timetables…
add.icsUrl: https://… or webcal://… link to the .ics file
add.guideIcs: The link is kept in your keyring: private addresses give access to anyone who has them. Guide: docs/ics.md
add.guideGoogle: Create a “Desktop app” OAuth client in your own Google Cloud project, then download its JSON file. Step by step: docs/google.md
add.googleWaiting: Finish signing in in your browser.
add.googleWaitingHint: Allow both calendar permissions. Agenda comes back here by itself when Google is done.
accounts.reconnecting: Finish signing in in your browser…
error.login_timeout: Nothing came back from the browser within 5 minutes. Try again.
error.login_busy: A sign-in is already waiting in the browser.
error.no_browser: No browser could be opened (xdg-open is missing).
error.google_client_file: That is not a Google OAuth client file. Download the JSON of a “Desktop app” client (docs/google.md).
error.google_client_web: This client is of type “Web application”. Create one of type “Desktop app” instead.
error.google_client_invalid: Google does not know this OAuth client. Was it deleted? Download a new one.
error.google_scopes: Agenda needs both calendar permissions. Sign in again and leave both boxes ticked.
error.google_no_refresh: Google did not grant offline access. Remove Agenda at myaccount.google.com › Security › Third-party access, then try again.
error.google_api_disabled: The Google Calendar API is not enabled in your Cloud project (docs/google.md, step 2).
error.reauth_required: Google signed this account out. If your OAuth app is in “Testing” mode, this happens every 7 days. Click “Sign in again”.
error.bad_feed: That link does not lead to a calendar (.ics) file.
error.bad_response: The server sent an answer that could not be read.
error.unknown_provider: This kind of account is not supported.
